title: Data and analysis code: Genotype-specific antioxidant, reactive-carbonyl and polyamine responses underlying heat tolerance in six winter wheat cultivars
description: Raw data and R scripts that reproduce every statistical analysis and figure of the manuscript "Genotype-specific antioxidant, reactive-carbonyl and polyamine responses underlying heat tolerance in six winter wheat cultivars" (Rahman, Habib et al.). Six Martonvasar winter wheat cultivars were grown at 20, 35 and 40 degrees C and profiled for shoot biomass, leaf gas exchange, photosynthetic pigments, ascorbate-glutathione enzymes, reactive-carbonyl detoxification enzymes, phenylalanine ammonia-lyase and free polyamines. Eight numbered scripts fit two-way linear models with Type II ANOVA and Tukey-adjusted comparisons within temperature, and run the principal component analysis, the stress-tolerance-index heatmap and the Spearman correlation matrix. Code is released under the MIT licence and the data files under CC BY 4.0.
